page.overview:
Who is Saburo?

Saburo was a middle-aged man of average stature. He was partially bald, with his messy black hair thinning at the front. He had sharp brown eyes and a pointed chin. He wore an expression that showed his fears about demons, appearing anxious and serious when meeting with Tanjiro.

Saburo wore a simple gray yukata, and an olive drab haori on top. He had baggy light-green pants, black socks, and green sandals.

Saburo possesses sharp discernment. He also displays sincerity towards young Tanjiro, willing to offer him his own house to take a rest in for a night due to his beliefs of man-eating demons coming out during the night, and it would be unsafe for travel. His knowledge about Demon Slayers and demons made him more aware and anxious than the average person, which was also due to his family's death because of them.

In the past, Saburo lost his family due to an attack by demons. As a result, he lived in fear of the night and stayed indoors. Consequently, he was also aware of the existence of the Demon Slayer Corps.
